title: Collisions, decays and invariant mass
summary: Total four-momentum and the invariant mass of a system; photons; thresholds for creating mass; two-body decays and the Compton effect by invariants; fission, fusion and annihilation in SI numbers.

objectives.description: Objectives will be finalised when the unit is prepared; the source material is Spacetime Physics Chapter 8, Tong Section 7.5, and MIT 8.20 Weeks 3–4 (Lectures 9.3, 10.3–10.7).

preparation.description: Read Spacetime Physics Chapter 8 Collide. Create. Annihilate. (pp. 221–274), including the Dialog on the concept of mass (p. 246).
Second account: Tong, Dynamics and Relativity, Section 7.5 Particle Physics (reference-only).
Optional: MIT 8.20 Week 3 Lecture 9.3 Collisions and Week 4 Lectures 10.3, 10.5, 10.6, 10.7.
